title: IVG Pro Salts Strawberry Raspberry Cherry 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Strawberry Raspberry Cherry 10ml E-Liquid is a beautifully layered and highly vibrant summer fruit medley. The experience begins with the soft, familiar sweetness of ripe Strawberry, which is quickly followed by the sharp, mouth-watering tang of fresh Raspberry. Finally, a robust note of dark Cherry emerges on the exhale to ground the profile, delivering a deeply satisfying and complex finish that fruit lovers will appreciate. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the vibrant fruit layers of Strawberry Raspberry Cherry, vapers can explore other standout options such as the sparkling zest of Lemon Fizz or the cooling tropical chill of Pineapple Ice, ensuring a premium choice for every preference.
